title: buxus flaviramea
intro: Buxus flaviramea, commonly known as boxwood, is a type of evergreen shrub native to Europe and Asia. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of boxwood include its potential to treat anxiety, insomnia, and other nervous system disorders, due to its sedative and calming effects. The bioactive constituents of boxwood include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
